praises: Radeon 780M is the best iGPU in any sub-$1,300 CA convertible — light gaming genuinely works
120Hz touch panel feels far smoother than the 60Hz panels on newer Envys
4.83/5 from Best Buy buyers on this exact listing
Strong Zen 4 multicore for video exports and compiles at this price
complaints: Heavy (~2.1 kg) — tablet mode is a token feature
HS chip runs warm and the fans audibly spin up under load in this thin chassis
Battery life mediocre (~7.5h) vs newer U-series convertibles
No NPU Copilot+ certification — excluded from some Windows AI features
Leftover stock: warranty clock started at original sale, limited units remain

design_philosophy: Last-generation Envy x360 16 hardware (Zen 4 Hawk Point) now cleared at aggressive pricing: raw CPU/GPU punch and a 120Hz panel that embarrass the current U-series refresh, at the cost of battery life and Copilot+ credentials. A classic leftover value pick.
rating_notes: Notable value pick (rule 10 previous-gen exception).
